title: fritillaria tenella var. intermedia
intro: Fritillaria tenella var. intermedia, commonly known as the Chinese goldenseal, is a plant species in the lily family (Liliaceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as bronchitis, coughs, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Fritillaria tenella var. intermedia include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, which help to relieve congestion and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as fritillarine and epifritillarine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
